## Requirements (from the contract)

1. Owner-bound slice only: executed instrument oracle + durable attempt
   evidence (partition X5; PADR-R5-1 A.1 item 5 + A.3; REQ-E-007
   primary). Reuse lower-layer codecs/stores; consume predecessor
   contracts unchanged — R5.10's `submission_seal` and R5.9's
   `selection::GradeAttempt` producer contract (AC-1, AC-2).
2. Positive: persist invocation **before** execution on the sealed
   submission with separate instrument funding; enforce frozen
   instrument-only regrade count/time/resource bounds; retain each
   attempt (actual pinned output/status/timeout + isolation evidence)
   through the existing reward/infra mapping; no participant feedback,
   no subject relaunch; correct/wrong/broken controls diverge (AC-1).
3. Negative: empty/nonfinite/crashed/timed-out/refused → oracle failure
   (never fabricated reward); pin/digest mismatch refuses; shared mode
   stays shared with `n/a{no_detector}` tamper; instrument costs never
   leak into subject (AC-2).
4. Ownership/evidence: REQ-E-007 primary resolved to numbered checks +
   actual evidence; contributors REQ-E-102/REQ-E-103/REQ-E-204 mapped;
   achieved D/E separate from owed R/P/actual-execution E; R5.43
   contributor evidence owed (AC-3).
5. Scoped verification: fails-without regression; `cargo fmt --all
   --check` + owning-package tests; drift/removability/CI-mode checks
   only if touched; counts recorded; scratch stores (AC-4).
6. Universal phase gate: green scope; REQ ids stamped; owed predicates as
   DEFERRALS rows with owner/trigger/control; ADRs for owned decisions;
   run/PR/BUILD_INDEX/LEDGER agree; O-01–O-08 + I-01–I-08 dispositions
   (AC-5).

## Plan

1. `crates/hh-ledger/src/classes.rs` — register the two instrument-run
   oracle classes under the existing `verification.*` plane (P4 prefix
   rule already homes `verification.*`; no plane/hosted-lowering change
   needed — missing entry = "none" by construction):
   `verification.oracle.invoked` + `verification.oracle.verdict`
   (`row_prov`, durable + provenance-mandatory like the sibling
   `verification.validator.*` rows; `default_charged_to` derives
   `instrument` from the `verification.*` prefix — R-ACC-3).
2. `crates/hh-bench/src/oracle.rs` (new module — the X5 owner seam;
   bench already carries the hh-ledger/hh-eval edges, no dep change):
   - `InstrumentPolicy` — frozen `{policy_ref, max_attempts,
     wall_ms_bound, output_bytes_bound}` (instrument-only regrade
     count/time/resource bounds, frozen at launch).
   - `OraclePin{oracle_ref, oracle_digest}` + `FrozenPins{subject_run_id,
     submission_ref, submission_digest, oracle_ref, oracle_digest}` —
     the grade binding's frozen pins the attempt must match.
   - `SealedSubmission{pins_ref, seal_ref: EventRef, submission}` — the
     sealed artifact + the subject run's `submission_seal` proof; no
     seal ref → `UnsealedSubmission` refusal (never grade a mutable
     workspace).
   - `OracleExecutor` — the instrument producer port (facade
     composition): `execute(task, submission) -> OracleObservation`;
     deterministic fixtures in tests; a real adapter/subprocess wires
     the same trait later. Offline slice: no process/container exec.
   - `OracleObservation{exit_code, timed_out, stdout, stderr,
     environment_error, wall_ms}` — the raw unchanged-oracle bytes.
   - `oracle_attempt(store, instrument_run_id, lease, spec, exec)` —
     validate pins/digests → durable-derived `attempt_no` (scan the run's
     `verification.oracle.invoked` rows for this
     `{subject_run, submission_ref, oracle_ref}`; `> max_attempts`
     refuses `AttemptCap`) → mint+append `verification.oracle.invoked`
     BEFORE execution (`causes[]` cites the subject run's seal row;
     append failure → `InvocationNotPersisted`, no execution) →
     `exec.execute` → enforce `wall_ms_bound`/`output_bytes_bound`
     (over-bound ⇒ timeout/output-bound oracle failure) → map through
     the existing `grade()` pipeline (`parse_typed_reward` +
     `detect_infrastructure_failure` — empty/nonfinite/crash/timeout/
     refusal ⇒ oracle failure, never a fabricated reward) → mint+append
     `verification.oracle.verdict` retaining
     `{attempt_ref, invocation_ref, subject_run, submission_ref,
     oracle_ref, attempt_no, policy_ref, cost_ref, outcome, execution
     {exit_code, timed_out, wall_ms, stdout/stderr bytes+digests, infra},
     isolation{mode, separate_verifier, held_out_access, tamper},
     charged_to:"instrument", finished_ms}`.
   - `OracleAttempt` — the retained consumer record;
     `to_grade_attempt(metric_ref) -> selection::GradeAttempt` (the
     R5.9 producer fact: instrument_run_id + verdict seq + subject/
     submission/oracle pins + cause coords + outcome).
   - `OracleError` — typed refusals (`EmptyPin`, `PinMismatch`,
     `DigestMismatch`, `UnsealedSubmission`, `AttemptCap`,
     `InvocationNotPersisted`, `RetentionFailed`, `Store`).
   - Isolation truth: `separate` ⇒ `separate_verifier:true` + held-out
     access evidence; `shared`/`hosted` ⇒ `separate_verifier:false` +
     `tamper:"n/a{no_detector}"` — never an enum upgrade.
3. `crates/hh-bench/src/lib.rs` — `pub mod oracle` + re-exports.
4. `crates/hh-bench/tests/r5_11.rs` — the AC-1/AC-2 battery over scratch
   `Store::open_test` instrument runs (minimal `RunKind::Experiment`
   manifest — the results-tests instrument-run idiom; non-agent runs
   hold their own fenced writer, never enter subject aggregates).
5. ADR-0390 — owned landing decisions (class naming under the existing
   plane, durable-derived attempt count, executor port shape, retained
   payload members, tamper/no_detector spelling, instrument-run manifest
   idiom); revisit triggers + adr-index regenerate.
6. Run ledger; PR `docs/build/pr/R5.11.md`; §6.5 close.

## Evidence report

AC-1: `OracleRunner::attempt` persists `verification.oracle.invoked` on the instrument run **before** the executor runs (durable ordering proven: invoked seq < verdict seq; append failure ⇒ `InvocationNotPersisted`, no execution) on a sealed submission whose `submission_seal` proof resolves structurally; frozen `max_attempts`/`wall_ms_bound`/`output_bytes_bound` enforced against the durable stream and the raw observation; every attempt retained with pinned stdout/stderr bytes+digests, exit, timeout, infra mapping and isolation evidence; separate instrument funding (`charged_to`/`cost_ref` = instrument). Correct (1e6/N), plausible wrong (0/C valid zero) and broken (oracle_failure) controls diverge. AC-2: empty/non-numeric/out-of-range/unparseable/crashed/timed-out/refused/over-bound are `OracleFailure` via the unchanged `grade()`/`detect_infrastructure_failure`/`parse_typed_reward` pipeline — never a fabricated reward; submission/oracle pin + submission/oracle digest mismatches refuse with zero rows; unsealed/non-seal/dangling seal refs refuse; shared stays `separate_verifier:false` + `tamper:"n/a{no_detector}"`; subject run stream untouched and `default_charged_to(verification.oracle.*)` = instrument. AC-3: REQ-E-007 mapped to the numbered battery; contributing REQ-E-102/103/204 stamped only; full-target predicates + actual-execution E owed to R5.43/R5.14/R5.22 per the coverage register. AC-4: commands+counts above; fails-without compile-red at base. AC-5: records agree; AMEND ruling ead62ae4 carried conspicuously (1,797 vs ≤750).
